response.original_title: {FAQ}- How do I upgrade my cabin on a Princess Cruise?
response.overview: You can upgrade your stateroom on +1-866-829-1280(US) Princess Cruises through the Princess Cruise Room Upgrade bidding program, +1-866-829-1280(US) by paying the fare difference directly, or via a complimentary upgrade. How it works: Eligible guests can place bids on higher stateroom categories +1-866-829-1280(US) (such as oceanview, balcony, deluxe balcony, mini-suite, or full suite) via email invitations or the Princess Cruise Room Upgrade portal. Contact Princess Cruises +1-866-829-1280(US) or your travel advisor to pay the fare difference for an available higher-category stateroom. On a Facebook group discussion, +1-866-829-1280(US) opinions on cabin changes and upgrades are mixed regarding fees and timing, with many members recommending working through a travel agent or Princess Vacation Planner to monitor availability.
